name: block-distribute-map-cap
summary: Zone.exe hosts at most 64 DISTINCT maps per process (BlockDistributeManager::bdm_Array[64]). Relocate the array and raise every count.
status: WORKING 2026-09-14: chained in build/Zone.maps.exe, a zone booted READY with BlockDistribute 105/124, block infos 307/1024, MapCluster nodes 22/36 (all above stock) and a bot joined; see NOTES-map-caps.md.

target.note: Chained builds (on top of mob-spawn-group-cap / quest-count-cap output) need --allow-hash-mismatch; none of those recipes touch these sites.

maps.why: The ctor's eh-vector count (push 0x40), the dtor's vector count and both bdm_Find bounds (cmp esi, imm8) are sign-extended imm8 operands: 127 is the ceiling. The dtor's unlink loop is unrolled 4 entries per iteration with a trip count of maps/4, so maps must be a multiple of 4 -> 124.
imm8 bounds cap it at 127; the destructor walks 4 entries per iteration (add eax, 0x40) with trip count maps/4.

why: BlockDistributeManager (?blockdistmanager@@3V..., a static at 0x8B7018) is exactly bdm_Array[64] of
{Name3 mapid; BlockingDistribute* block} - 1024 bytes. bdm_Find (0x438F70) searches it by map name and
takes the first free slot; when all 64 are used it ac_Asserts and ShineExits: one slot per distinct map
name loaded by the process, which is the 64-maps-per-zone limit.
The object is referenced by address in exactly three places (tools/xref_range.py --range
0x8B7018-0x8B7418, no data-section pointer): mbi_Load's call to bdm_Find, the CRT ctor stub and the
atexit dtor stub - all `mov ecx, imm32`. So it relocates to a fresh section with three immediates.
Everything else that knows the size is a count, never an end pointer:
ctor 0x438AC0:   push 0x40 (eh vector ctor, imm8)   mov edi, 0x40 (name init loop, imm32)
dtor 0x438B20:   mov esi, 0x10 (= 64/4, loop unrolled x4, imm32)   push 0x40 (vector dtor, imm8)
bdm_Find:        cmp esi, 0x40 (loop bound, imm8)   cmp esi, 0x40 (the 'full' test, imm8)
The section is materialised (real zero bytes on disk) because the ctor is what initialises it and a
BSS section has not been proven under this loader (mob-spawn-group-cap notes).

edits.why: CRT init stub: this for the ctor
atexit stub: this for the dtor
ctor: eh vector ctor element count (imm8)
dtor: eh vector dtor element count (imm8)
